name: ai-model-router

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,Web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/dashboard
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/api && npm run lint --workspace=apps/dashboard
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test --workspace=apps/dashboard && npm run build

description: Self-hosted LLM routing engine: task-aware model selection with cost, latency and quality trade-offs.
